title: A letter to Duke Wilhelm V of Bavaria, 12 June 1583, in a Latin-letter cipher, BayHStA Kurbayern Äußeres Archiv 4591 ff.274-277 (DECODE R9424; catalogue 161)

steps.what: Web search for KAA 4591 and Augurelio ciphers
DECODE record list from the API dump (141 records in the volume); images of the 14 targets and 30 neighbouring keys fetched with the cookie
Constrained homophonic annealing with de-modern on R9424
R9422 (1582-83) Latin-letter alphabet applied to R9424
Annealing with nulls allowed on R9424 (de-1500s, homophone caps; also Latin and Italian): failed

Split under the one-key rule (George Lasry, 14 Oct 2026) from kaa4591 (catalogue 161), whose fourteen records are letters in at least six systems: System A′ stays in kaa4591; Łaski's System B is kaa4591b; R9325 is fulda1576; R9367, R9416, R9424 and R9319 are r9367, r9416, r9424 and r9319; R9291 is a key fragment.

outcome.method_basis: No key in the volume fits and annealing in German, Latin and Italian gives no text; the glosses over single groups suggest code groups.
outcome.notes: Attempted 21 Sept 2026 and closed: probably code groups plus transcription noise; gloss cribs too few.

gaps.detail: R9420-R9422 do not fit; annealing fails; few gloss cribs

prior.where: Glosses over a few names on f.275r (Hildesheim, Würzburg, Eichstätt, Freising); no edition found.

human: Project-level: DECODE login cookie supplied; problem posed with /goal; the user asked for a period German model. No target-specific intervention.
